visual_coarse.goal: Approach the patterned gray bowl for transfer to the stove.

visual_call: Current wrist RGB crop for above/center/below classification relative to its horizontal center line
required_inputs.deterministic_mapping: Fixed publicly verified orientation map converts the typed relation into the selected world-X direction.

visual_coarse.observable_exit_condition: Switch to numerical_fine when fine_readiness is true or the visual relation is center.

numerical_fine.goal: Continue the preserved sequence after approach: align, descend, grasp, lift, carry to the stove, lower, release, retreat.

motor_call: Current phase, gripper, and holding feedback
required_inputs.feedback_source: Algorithms using permitted images and robot state only, never scene truth; image decisions remain separate calls.

numerical_fine.observable_exit_condition: Existing phase feedback indicates sequence completion; native success remains unchanged.
